title: Governed goal-to-catalogue flow
desired_outcome: A user-approved goal reliably becomes governed milestone work, validated catalogue metadata, proof, and review without storing private execution content.
scope: Define a reusable goal prompt and a human-approved canonical goal record.
Connect approved goals to milestone execution, ingestion, verification, proof, review, and catalogue discovery.
non_goals: Do not execute prompts or store raw prompt conversations, hidden reasoning, credentials, or customer data.
Do not let an unapproved goal publish a catalogue entry or mark a milestone complete.
success_criteria: A reusable prompt can capture a bounded goal and candidate milestones.
Only a human-approved goal record is represented in the generated catalogue.
The approved goal links to a milestone that has validation, proof, and Review Triad evidence.
proof_requirements: Catalogue build validates prompt, template, and approved-goal source records and emits privacy-safe metadata.
Milestone close-check verifies the declared ingestion sources, successful commands, proof, and required reviews.
authority: Repository owner authorised this governed goal-flow implementation and its approved record on 2026-08-29.
